checkpoint_scope: official mixed union trained, not source-only
model: same released 256 queries,6decoder,headingFalse; entire parameter+buffer frozen eval
readout: All actual token logits incl specials/sentinel in softmax denominator at T=.07, then existing text-only first-noun mask sum. No category label. Full caption/context masks saved but not interpreted as grounding correctness.
noun_intervention: actual model re-run with first lexicon noun + . not mentioned sentinel; missing noun explicitly identity intervention, never GT fallback.
tokens: proj_tokens are normalized post-cross-encoder point-conditioned language memory, not independent text teacher.
reference_pool: full/view0 boxes 256x6 with unmodified center/size, yaw0, plus fixed round3 p3 standard-axisaware PCA yaw computed from its own full/view0 sampled points for each candidate. Other5 conditions evidence only; no index identity assumption.
correspondence: detached Hungarian center+size cost, normalize by max(median(abs reference dimensions),.5), maps reference row to evidence column; geometry correspondence not identity proof.
PCA: read-only round3/p3 geometry_baselines crop_source_aabb then orientation_only_from_crop(PCA_standard_axisaware). No legacy L/W1.5 gate, no geometry refit. Degenerate/invalid-size fallback retains source yaw0.
